main_body: shrine building with sloped copper-green roof and front walls/doors
top_band: copper-green sloped roof and ridge from row 4 to 42 (plus gold katsuogi ornaments rows 0-3)
evidence: The building shows a large foreshortened sloped roof surface (rows 4-42) above the red lintel beam (rows 43-45), overhang shadow (row 46), recessed lattice doors and plaster walls (rows 47-72), and stone base (rows 73-78).

style.evidence: The roof has 5 teal steps, wood has 4-5 red-orange steps, and outlines use dark brown/dark teal material tones. However, compared to the Beodeul reference buildings, the plaster walls have very faint, low-contrast speckle that reads almost flat at 2x, the roof lacks per-tile horizontal scallop breaking (using mostly long vertical runs), and the lattice doors are a mechanical 2x2 grid lacking organic wood grain and hardware detail.
